concept: One bill spike on a jade counter with a week of printed enquiry dockets on it, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot three ways. Wide: the whole tower, Friday 16:42 on top, and the foot of Monday 09:05 sticking out underneath. Then right up against that foot, the tower running off the top. Then from above, the pile turned over, Monday on top. Jade, till-roll white, polished steel and a white serif with one italic word a frame.
